top_stories.title: Bitcoin Holds Near $81,000 Amid Fed Policy and Shifting Investor Base
points: Bitcoin price hovered around $81,000, staying below the $81,000-$82,500 resistance zone, following the Federal Reserve's rate decision
Treasury yields near 5% are offering investors a competitive safe-return alternative, dampening Bitcoin demand

Nine hedge funds and banks cut spot Bitcoin ETF (exchange-traded fund, a security that tracks Bitcoin's price and trades on stock exchanges) holdings by 68,000 BTC as the profitable cash-and-carry arbitrage trade (simultaneously buying Bitcoin spot and selling futures to lock in a price difference) dried up
Sovereign wealth funds stepped in as net buyers, filling the gap left by Wall Street and signaling a shift toward longer-term strategic holders

unique_angles.point: Framed price stability above $81,000 as a sign of market confidence despite macro policy changes

Federal Reserve voted 10-2 to hold rates at 3.75%-4%, with two officials dissenting in favor of a hike, and upgraded its economic outlook from 'solid' to 'strong'; traders now price December rate-hike odds above 70%

items.title: Google's Crypto Custody Launch for Banks
points: Google is launching a crypto custody service for banks in 2027, using a split-key security system (cryptographic keys divided among multiple parties so no single entity can access funds alone, reducing theft risk)
Major financial institutions are currently testing Google's custody infrastructure ahead of the planned 2027 commercial launch
Move signals a major tech company's entry into institutional crypto storage, addressing a key barrier to traditional finance adopting digital assets

items.title: Moody's Rates Ripple's RLUSD Stablecoin A2
points: Moody's assigned an A2 credit rating to Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin (a cryptocurrency pegged to the US dollar, backed by $2.6 billion in reserves), one day after the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency approved a bank to hold it
The rating notes that RLUSD holders currently lack a direct ownership interest in the Treasury-heavy reserves backing the token

items.title: Corporations Object to Tokenized Share Trading on OKX-ICE
points: Seven major companies, including JPMorgan Chase and Coca-Cola, formally objected to trading tokenized (blockchain-based digital representations of) versions of their shares on the OKX-ICE platform
Objection raises legal and regulatory questions about secondary markets for digitized equities

sections.title: Fed Decision Maintains Hawkish Posture Despite Rate Hold
points: Federal Reserve voted 10-2 to keep interest rates unchanged at 3.75%-4%, but Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented in favor of another quarter-point increase
Central bank upgraded economic assessment from 'solid' to 'strong,' signaling confidence in economy despite inflation concerns
Market traders now price probability of rate hike at December 8-9 meeting above 70%, suggesting Fed may not be finished tightening despite current pause
